svg.title: 01 SHADOW | 1:1 printer scale and logo footprint check | NOT vendor-approved
svg.desc: Physical measurement reference only. No proprietary wordmark or approved chest placement. Print at actual size, never fit-to-page. Verify 100mm control before using 82mm footprint.

g.text: NO LOGO · NO APPROVED POSITION · DO NOT UPLOAD TO VENDOR
